headline: Handcrafted Florentine leather for lasting elegance
body: Commission a custom-fit handbag crafted by artisans in Florence. Built with traditional Italian methods for enduring quality.
rationale: This copy addresses an affluent classic shopper by focusing entirely on heritage, craftsmanship, and understated quality without mentioning price or discounts. It completely avoids trendy language, loud aesthetics, and influencer positioning, directly reflecting the persona preferences.
